Teri Tangaan Che Dunya Taun Safar Veran Main Kar Jana.
Jay Wal Na Aawein Ga Akbar Main Mar Janra Main Mar Janra.

1
Si Chali Veriyaan Andar Aykho Kam Sainr Sughra Da.
Charagaan Nu Jala Ke Bohiyaan De Naal Dhar Jana.
Bhira De Sir Nu Chum Ke Wain Kardi Re Gayi Sughra.
Jiwein Mehmal Taun Utari Aan Qabar Wich V Utar Jana.

2
Hajay Toon Veer Rukhsat Te Madine Choon Nahi Hoya.
Tere Janday Hi Yasrab Ne Veerani Naal Bhar Jana.
Aina Nanay De Rozay Te V Jana Rook Dena Aye.
Fidak Wangoon Musalmana Ziyarat Taun Mukar Jana.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 10 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both versions have the same two-line opening and two four-line stanzas.

The verses support Punjabi metadata. I removed the missing-source tag and dropped “New Lyrics 2025” from the display title. I read the ambiguous `Sainr` as `سائیں` and `Veran` as `ویران`. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
